A '''fox pelt''' is meant to drop from foxes. The pack gives it two textures, red and snowy, to match the fox it came from. It is the same item as {{ItemLink|Tattered Leather}} (a rabbit hide) with its own name and look, so it can be used anywhere tattered leather is. In 1.12.4 foxes drop nothing, because of a [[Known bugs#Other|bug]] in their loot table.

== Obtaining ==
=== Mob loot ===
The fox loot table is meant to drop one fox pelt from every fox: red foxes the red pelt, through the table <code>matcha:materials/fox_pelt</code>, and snow foxes the snowy pelt. It also drops 1 raw flesh (cooked if the fox was burning), plus 0–1 per level of Looting. In vanilla, foxes drop nothing but their held item.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/fox.json}}</ref>

In 1.12.4 the table can't be loaded: the red pelt's entry names its table with <code>name</code> where the game expects <code>value</code>, and the snowy pelt's entry asks for an item called <code>matcha:materials/fox_pelt_snowy</code>, which is the name of a loot table, not an item. Either mistake makes the game reject the whole file, so foxes drop no pelt and no raw flesh, only their held item.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/fox.json}}</ref> See [[Known bugs#Other|Known bugs]].

The pelts themselves are defined in two small loot tables, <code>matcha:materials/fox_pelt</code> and <code>matcha:materials/fox_pelt_snowy</code>, which work with the <code>/loot</code> command.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fox_pelt.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fox_pelt_snowy.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
Recipes that take tattered leather accept fox pelts, because recipes check the item type, not its name. See [[tattered leather#Usage]].

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Snowy foxes drop their own snowy pelt instead of the red one.}}
{{History line|1.12.4|The pelts' item models now have the <code>matcha</code> namespace, which fixes their missing-model texture. The fox loot table was rewritten to use the new pelt tables, but the rewrite can't be loaded, so foxes drop nothing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fox_pelt.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/fox.json}}</ref>}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* Until 1.12.4, the loot table gave the pelts the item models <code>fox_pelt</code> and <code>fox_pelt_snowy</code> without a namespace, which the game reads as <code>minecraft:fox_pelt</code>. The resource pack defines the models under the <code>matcha</code> namespace, so neither model was found and dropped pelts showed the missing-model texture.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/matcha/items/fox_pelt.json}}</ref>
